designationHistory.indexText: Lake Woodruff National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1964 as a migratory bird refuge to offset losses of wetland habitat that were occurring in central Florida.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
